now.title: Daredevil S3
now.text: Posing as Daredevil, Dex wields a copied billy club in his attack on the Bulletin and stabs Ellison with it.

proposed.text: Posing as Daredevil, Dex wields a copied billy club in his attack on the Bulletin, where he stabs Ellison in the gut with a pen.

changes.evidence: Daredevil S3 episode 6: the impostor in Daredevil's suit, armed with a billy club, disarms Karen by throwing it at her gun, knocks out Foggy and impales Ellison in the gut with a pen, not the club.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: Five years later, Peter and his suits return from the Snap, and he fights Thanos's army in the Iron Spider.

changes.evidence: The file leaves the suits 'Lost' at the Snap in Infinity War; in Endgame (2023) Peter and the Stark suit are restored by the Blip and he joins the Battle of Earth wearing the Iron Spider.
